caption:
Your pancreas quietly controls blood sugar, and okra's sticky fiber slows how fast glucose hits your bloodstream while bitter melon contains compounds that mimic insulin's effect on your cells. Your kidneys filter about 50 gallons of blood a day, and cranberries work by preventing bacteria from clinging to the urinary tract walls, which is why they're linked to fewer infections. Pomegranate deserves a mention too — its polyphenols help relax blood vessels and improve circulation, which takes pressure off your heart and blood vessels over time. Of course, everyone's body responds a little differently, so pay attention to what actually works for yours.
